name: promotions_sdk
_comment_version_1_3_0: 1.2.3 -> 1.3.0: demo runs the REAL repositories (Ray, 2026-09-25: "touch all sdk demos ... remove unused files"). The DI hooks register the real repositories only and call DemoFixtures.registerAssetDirectory('assets/demo/promotions'); base_sdk 1.73.0's DemoGatewayInterceptor answers each platform cmd from templates/assets/demo/promotions/<cmd>.json (installed to assets/demo/promotions) while DemoSession.demoActive, and an unknown cmd fails with DemoFixtureMissing. The api.banner.* fixtures carry (the Weeknight deals / New Arrivals banners for Nonna's Pizzeria). Deleted: MockBannersRepository and the demo-session swap code that chose them. Needs base_sdk >= 1.73.0 (DemoFixtures / DemoGatewayInterceptor).
_comment_requires: promotions_sdk >= 1.3.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.73.0 (DemoFixtures.registerAssetDirectory and the DemoGatewayInterceptor that answers the demo fixtures).

routes._comment: Pre-fork story viewer route recovered (fix-wave 2026-09-02, route map row 17): `/storyList?index=<n>` deep links keep resolving via @QueryParam; the shell lives in promotions_route_pages.dart. Top-level: this manifest has no flavour blocks and promotions_sdk composes only into customer-family apps.

app_routes.body: context.router.push(StoryListRoute(index: (index is int) ? index : int.tryParse('$index') ?? 0, controller: controller));

_comment_app_routes: Fills base_sdk's AppRoutes.pushStoryListRoute seam (marketplace's story bar tiles call it). `params` must match base_sdk's signature verbatim; the dynamic `controller` is the caller's pull-to-refresh RefreshController (or null).
